reviews.rationale: No item isolates generative AI's realized aggregate productivity contribution in 2024 Q4. e1 offers only a modeled potential gain and explicitly says the measured effect is uncertain. e2 and e3 cover later or broader periods and are correlational. Taken together they lean toward a limited realized effect but do not meet the support or contradiction condition.
